en.text: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

zhSimplified.text: 银子有矿； 炼金有方。

zhTraditional.text: 銀子有礦； 煉金有方。

en.text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

zhSimplified.text: 铁从地里挖出； 铜从石中熔化。

zhTraditional.text: 鐵從地裏挖出； 銅從石中鎔化。

en.text: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 人为黑暗定界限， 查究幽暗阴翳的石头，直到极处，

zhTraditional.text: 人為黑暗定界限， 查究幽暗陰翳的石頭，直到極處，

en.text: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

zhSimplified.text: 在无人居住之处刨开矿穴， 过路的人也想不到他们； 又与人远离，悬在空中摇来摇去。

zhTraditional.text: 在無人居住之處刨開礦穴， 過路的人也想不到他們； 又與人遠離，懸在空中搖來搖去。

en.text: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

zhSimplified.text: 至于地，能出粮食， 地内好像被火翻起来。

zhTraditional.text: 至於地，能出糧食， 地內好像被火翻起來。

en.text: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

zhSimplified.text: 地中的石头有蓝宝石， 并有金沙。

zhTraditional.text: 地中的石頭有藍寶石， 並有金沙。

en.text: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

zhSimplified.text: 矿中的路鸷鸟不得知道； 鹰眼也未见过。

zhTraditional.text: 礦中的路鷙鳥不得知道； 鷹眼也未見過。

en.text: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

zhSimplified.text: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过； 猛烈的狮子也未曾经过。

zhTraditional.text: 狂傲的野獸未曾行過； 猛烈的獅子也未曾經過。

en.text: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

zhSimplified.text: 人伸手凿开坚石， 倾倒山根，

zhTraditional.text: 人伸手鑿開堅石， 傾倒山根，

en.text: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

zhSimplified.text: 在磐石中凿出水道， 亲眼看见各样宝物。

zhTraditional.text: 在磐石中鑿出水道， 親眼看見各樣寶物。

en.text: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

zhSimplified.text: 他封闭水不得滴流， 使隐藏的物显露出来。

zhTraditional.text: 他封閉水不得滴流， 使隱藏的物顯露出來。

en.text: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

zhSimplified.text: 然而，智慧有何处可寻？ 聪明之处在哪里呢？

zhTraditional.text: 然而，智慧有何處可尋？ 聰明之處在哪裏呢？

en.text: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧的价值无人能知， 在活人之地也无处可寻。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧的價值無人能知， 在活人之地也無處可尋。

en.text: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

zhSimplified.text: 深渊说：不在我内； 沧海说：不在我中。

zhTraditional.text: 深淵說：不在我內； 滄海說：不在我中。

en.text: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧非用黄金可得， 也不能平白银为它的价值。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧非用黃金可得， 也不能平白銀為它的價值。

en.text: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

zhSimplified.text: 俄斐金和贵重的红玛瑙， 并蓝宝石，不足与较量；

zhTraditional.text: 俄斐金和貴重的紅瑪瑙， 並藍寶石，不足與較量；

en.text: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

zhSimplified.text: 黄金和玻璃不足与比较； 精金的器皿不足与兑换。

zhTraditional.text: 黃金和玻璃不足與比較； 精金的器皿不足與兌換。

en.text: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

zhSimplified.text: 珊瑚、水晶都不足论； 智慧的价值胜过珍珠。

zhTraditional.text: 珊瑚、水晶都不足論； 智慧的價值勝過珍珠。

en.text: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

zhSimplified.text: 古实的红璧玺不足与比较； 精金也不足与较量。

zhTraditional.text: 古實的紅璧璽不足與比較； 精金也不足與較量。

en.text: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

zhSimplified.text: 智慧从何处来呢？ 聪明之处在哪里呢？

zhTraditional.text: 智慧從何處來呢？ 聰明之處在哪裏呢？

en.text: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

zhSimplified.text: 是向一切有生命的眼目隐藏， 向空中的飞鸟掩蔽。

zhTraditional.text: 是向一切有生命的眼目隱藏， 向空中的飛鳥掩蔽。

en.text: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

zhSimplified.text: 灭没和死亡说： 我们风闻其名。

zhTraditional.text: 滅沒和死亡說： 我們風聞其名。

en.text: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

zhSimplified.text: 神明白智慧的道路， 晓得智慧的所在。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝明白智慧的道路， 曉得智慧的所在。

en.text: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

zhSimplified.text: 因他鉴察直到地极， 遍观普天之下，

zhTraditional.text: 因他鑒察直到地極， 遍觀普天之下，

en.text: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

zhSimplified.text: 要为风定轻重， 又度量诸水；

zhTraditional.text: 要為風定輕重， 又度量諸水；

en.text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

zhSimplified.text: 他为雨露定命令， 为雷电定道路。

zhTraditional.text: 他為雨露定命令， 為雷電定道路。

en.text: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

zhSimplified.text: 那时他看见智慧，而且述说； 他坚定，并且查究。

zhTraditional.text: 那時他看見智慧，而且述說； 他堅定，並且查究。

en.text: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

zhSimplified.text: 他对人说：敬畏主就是智慧； 远离恶便是聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 他對人說：敬畏主就是智慧； 遠離惡便是聰明。
